blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Senate impeachment court on Wednesday decided to reduce the number of votes needed to convict Vice President Sara Duterte. This came after the majority of the senator-judges voted to reduce the conviction threshold after both the defense and prosecution’s oral arguments on the matter. READ: Here’s what amici curiae say about the impeachment voting threshold If she ever does get convicted, Duterte faces possible removal from office and perpetual disqualification from holding any public office. To note, several senators have yet to participate in the trial, namely Sens. Jinggoy Estrada, Rodante Marcoleta, and Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa. […]...
